title: Skill-loading cost
summary: Progressive disclosure is not universal across every agent configuration.

sections.label: Verified behavior
sections.text: The Agent Skills specification describes progressive loading. Copilot SDK skills explicitly assigned to a custom agent are eagerly injected in full at startup; children do not automatically inherit all parent skills.

sections.label: Proposed practice
sections.text: Assign only needed skills to each role. Inspect actual prompt/context usage and keep supporting resources separate where the runtime loads them on demand.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The agent has enough procedural guidance without every project runbook appearing in every session.

catalog.applicability: Use when assigning skills to agents or custom agents, since the Copilot SDK injects explicitly assigned skills in full at startup and children do not inherit every parent skill. Assign only the skills each role needs and inspect the actual prompt and context usage.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
